front.title: DHCP and DHCPv6 Options for an AI Gateway URI

abstract.t: This document specifies a DHCPv4 option and a DHCPv6 option that carry the HTTPS URI of an AI gateway descriptor. The descriptor is a Provisioning Domain Additional Information document. It identifies a forward proxy and the destinations for which that proxy is to be used. The DHCP options do not carry proxy credentials, model identifiers, or a Proxy Auto-Configuration script.
